name: @bloodtrail/security-audit-sdk-core
description: Framework-independent, contract-bound TypeScript SDK core for Bloodtrail security audit events

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated-validator.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:matrix: npm run generate && npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:types && npm run test:examples && npm run test:exports && npm run test:compatibility && npm run test:scope && npm run test:dependencies
scripts.validate: npm run generate && npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:types && npm run test:examples && npm run test:exports && npm run test:compatibility && npm run test:contract-immutability && npm run test:scope && npm run test:dependencies && npm run test:package && npm run test:changed-paths && npm run test:coherence && npm run test:verification && npm run test:git
